# @wirecat/cli-base "./standards/tables": the stable API, written by cli-dev api-report. Do not edit.
FLAG_ROLES · const · export declare const FLAG_ROLES: {
FLAG_ROLES · const · readonly paging: "which part of a long answer: how many, which page, where to continue";
FLAG_ROLES · const · readonly output: "how the answer is shaped or shown";
FLAG_ROLES · const · readonly sort: "the order of the answer";
FLAG_ROLES · const · readonly mode: "how the command runs, not what it reads";
FLAG_ROLES · const · readonly action: "does something extra besides the answer";
FLAG_ROLES · const · readonly budget: "how much time or work the command may spend";
FLAG_ROLES · const · readonly scope: "which accounts, providers or sources are read; never picked for you, so a flag and not a query field";
FLAG_ROLES · const · readonly target: "which thing or time window the command acts on, when that is not a list's filter";
FLAG_ROLES · const · readonly value: "sets a field on a write";
FLAG_ROLES · const · readonly query: "a query in the query language, beside a search's own words";
FLAG_ROLES · const · };
FLAG_TYPES · const · export declare const FLAG_TYPES: readonly ["switch", "count", "number", "string", "id", "time", "duration", "choice", "list", "path", "cursor"];
FlagRole · type · export type FlagRole = keyof typeof FLAG_ROLES;
FlagType · type · export type FlagType = (typeof FLAG_TYPES)[number];
